Container.Name: Gitea-Mirror
Container.Overview: Gitea Mirror automatically mirrors your GitHub repositories (including organizations, starred repos, etc.) to a self-hosted Gitea instance. Set BETTER_AUTH_SECRET (openssl rand -base64 32) and ENCRYPTION_SECRET (openssl rand -base64 48) explicitly so they are kept with your container config; if left empty they are auto-generated and stored in the data folder. Make sure the URL variables match the address you use to open the WebUI.

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Required. Signs session tokens (min 32 chars). Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

Config.Name: ENCRYPTION_SECRET
Config.Description: Recommended. Encrypts stored GitHub/Gitea/notification tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48. If empty, one is auto-generated and stored in /app/data/.encryption_secret. If lost, tokens must be re-entered.

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
Config.Description: URL you use to access the WebUI, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:4321

Config.Name: PUBLIC_BETTER_AUTH_URL
Config.Description: Same as BETTER_AUTH_URL (public address of the WebUI)

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of trusted origins; include the WebUI address (and reverse proxy domain if used)
